noInherit.description: If true, the annotation is not inherited by mixins.

dimension.description: Number of elements in the vector.

sparse.description: Whether the vector is sparse or dense.

sourceField.description:
Source field path in the parent type. If set this vector field becomes read only
and will be maintained by Db.Engine. Similar to `stored calc` field.

embedder.description: Embedder for this vector. If specified then {@link #dimension} should be blank
